page.notes: Left margin notes are set in small italic type: "v. & Iannab. An. Heir. 8°." (top), "* i. e. Lapide Achate rubro." (middle, marked with asterisk in text), and "ꝏ و غيرهم aliorúmque Allannab. صور الاذلام i. e. figuras prophetarum. Camel." (lower). The Arabic and Hebrew are transcribed as best read; the Arabic of the lower-right block and the Hebrew words are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The line "Quid Abra-/hamo" is continued at the foot right as "hamo" (catchword). Several Arabic words in the Caaba passage are doubtful. Printed text marked with * refers to the margin note on red agate.
